item.title: Solved: How to Display Numbers with Leading Zeros in Python
item.description:
When working with numbers in Python, especially in contexts like data display, it’s often necessary to format them with leading zeros. This can help maintain consistency, particularly when dealing with single-digit and double-digit numbers. In this post, we will delve into the various methods available in Python to achieve this, providing practical examples along the way.

Top 5 Methods to Format Numbers with Leading Zeros in Python

  1. Using str.zfill()

The most straightforward method to add leading zeros is using the str.zfill() method. This method pads the string representation of the number with zeros on the left until it reaches the specified length.

item.title: Solved: How to Resolve the 'Lock Wait Timeout Exceeded' Error in MySQL
item.description:
Are you encountering the error “Lock wait timeout exceeded; try restarting transaction” in MySQL even though you’re not using any transactions? This can be frustrating, especially when restarting the server doesn’t resolve the issue. Let’s dive deep into understanding the cause of this error and explore effective solutions to fix it.

Why Do You See the “Lock Wait Timeout Exceeded” Error?

In MySQL, the LOCK WAIT TIMEOUT error usually occurs when a transaction or operation is blocked because another operation is holding a lock on a resource for too long. However, this doesn’t necessarily mean that you’re using explicit transactions in your queries.
